text:
# Professional roles: Andrew Ng (sub-question: professional_roles)

## Summary
The official site (andrewng.org) lists several roles in present tense and some in past tense. I recorded six evidence items, which is the cap. The site's primary-source links do not confirm most of these roles. Only LandingAI's page was checked, and it did not name Ng.

## Recorded evidence
- **E1**: Founder of DeepLearning.AI (current, per site bio), quote: "the Founder of DeepLearning.AI"
- **E2**: Managing General Partner at AI Fund (current), quote: "Managing General Partner at AI Fund"
- **E3**: Executive Chairman of LandingAI (current), quote: "Executive Chairman of LandingAI"
- **E4**: Chairman and Co-Founder of Coursera (current), quote: "Chairman and Co-Founder of Coursera"
- **E5**: Adjunct Professor at Stanford University (current), quote: "an Adjunct Professor at Stanford University"
- **E6**: VP & Chief Scientist at Baidu (past tense), quote: "He served as VP & Chief Scientist at Baidu"

## Other roles on the site (not recorded, cap reached)
- Managing Partner at AI Aspire (present tense per site summary)
- Founding lead of the Google Brain team (past tense)
- Formerly Director of the Stanford AI Lab (past tense)
- Co-founder of Coursera in 2012 (per the company description)
- Time100 AI listing (2023), and education: B.Sc. CMU, M.Sc. MIT, Ph.D. UC Berkeley

## Sources inspected
1. https://www.andrewng.org/ (identity anchor, personal website). Fetched twice. The quotes come from the fetch tool's extracted text, not from a direct copy of the page HTML. The "current" vs. "past" split is inferred from tense, because the page has no explicit labels.
2. https://landing.ai/ (primary source linked from the site). It does not name Ng or describe his role. Footer shows "2026 ©LandingAI. All rights reserved." It has a "Leadership" link, which I did not follow.

## Rejected identity candidates
None. Every page inspected was the subject's own site or a company page tied to it.

## Gaps
- **Primary sources not checked:** deeplearning.ai, aifund.ai, aiaspire.ai, coursera.org, Stanford, Google, and Baidu pages. The site links to several of these, but I did not fetch them.
- **Dates missing:** No start or end dates for any role. Coursera's 2012 co-founding is per the summary only, not recorded.
- **Current status unverified:** Whether each role is still held as of 2026-10-31 rests on the site's own tense. Independent confirmation is needed, especially for LandingAI, where the company page did not confirm Ng's role.
- **Unverified site claims:** The site summary mentions Baidu's "1,300-person AI team," Time100 AI (2023), and degree details. None were checked against primary sources.
- **Evidence status:** All six records await independent factual validation.
